<description>
A few of our longer-running tests have some unnecessary waits and timeouts in them. Reduce or replace them to shorten test times:

- in `p2p_node_network_limited` replace the expected sync timeout with header/ping barriers and a bounded negative check. At CI timeout factor 40, saves roughly 195 seconds per transport.
- in `interface_ipc_mining` cap three expected no-event waits at five seconds, saving roughly 105 seconds at factor 40 in CI.
- in `WalletLoadingDescriptors` honor sanity mode’s single epoch, avoiding four unnecessary wallet unload/load cycles.
- two wallet unit tests switch to `BasicTestingSetup` avoiding construction of two unused 100-block chains.

The timeout changes alone save approximately eight minutes of accumulated test-worker time on CI jobs running both transports and IPC mining. Wall-clock savings depend on parallel scheduling, CPU etc.
</description>
